description: Header file defining the D3DTextureSurfaceWGL class, which implements egl::Surface for D3D texture interop using WGL in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL
classes.description: WGL implementation of egl::Surface for D3D texture interop, managing D3D textures within an EGL surface context.

methods.name: D3DTextureSurfaceWGL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the surface with device context, D3D device, and function pointers.

methods.name: ValidateD3DTextureClientBuffer
methods.description: Validates the D3D texture client buffer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface with display info.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current in the given context.

methods.name: unMakeCurrent
methods.description: Releases the surface from the current context.

methods.name: postSubBuffer
methods.description: Posts a sub-region of the buffer.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture image to the surface.

methods.name: isPostSubBufferSupported
methods.description: Checks if post sub-buffer is supported.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates default framebuffer for the surface.

methods.name: getD3DTextureColorFormat
methods.description: Returns the color format of the D3D texture.
